scope: Public-source discovery for Fresno County and connected supply systems. This is a reference inventory, not a verified hydraulic or operating network.

priorityAgencies: CCID / Firebaugh Canal Water District and Exchange Contractors
Westlands / SLDMWA / Friant Water Authority / Reclamation
fields: Stable asset ID and local name
Asset type, owner and responsible operator
Geometry with horizontal CRS, datum, accuracy and revision date
From-node / to-node IDs and flow-direction qualifications
Headgates, check structures, turnouts, interties, culverts, siphons and pumps
Active, replaced, abandoned, proposed and seasonal classifications
Capacity with units, basis, date and operator confirmation
Read-only status/telemetry source, observation time and expected update interval
Power dependency, backup-power status and owner confirmation where approved
Public / county / partner sharing classification and written use/redistribution permission
request.format: Read-only ArcGIS feature services or file geodatabase / GeoPackage preferred; relationship tables and a field/domain dictionary included. GeoParquet is also suitable for prepared line and point data.
request.review: Validate intake and outlet links with each operator. A line crossing, matching name, district polygon or nearest point is not proof of connection. Unknown gate/pump states remain unknown.
